post.text:
We secured the 218th and final signature needed to force a House vote on the Major Richard Star Act.

Combat-injured veterans should never have to choose between the retirement pay they earned through service and the disability compensation they deserve for their injuries. Under current law, many medically retired veterans lose part of their earned retirement pay simply because they receive disability compensation.

The Major Richard Star Act ends this penalty for all veterans with combat-related disabilities, including those with fewer than 20 years of service.

Our veterans kept their promise to America. Now Congress must keep its promise to them.
